referencePolicy.pathBase: Repository root; keep the submission directory layout when extracting a package
referencePolicy.evidencePaths: Paths identify produced files beneath submission/evidence or existing submission artifacts. A path plus jsonPointer identifies a record within a produced JSON file, not a JPEG image.
referencePolicy.originalNames: originalSourceArtifactName/originalSourceFrameName/originalRunnerArtifactName are provenance labels, not downloadable artifact references.
referencePolicy.observedRuntimeAddresses: Loopback URLs retained inside observations identify the actually exercised local surface; they are not portable download links or hosted-test claims.
referencePolicy.sourceFootage: Original encoded footage is a separate versioned release asset; source identity is recorded in its provenance descriptor, and actual public access/download evidence is separately recorded in https://github.com/ilyanaxo/offcut-webmcp/blob/main/submission/publication-verification.json. No original JPEG set is copied.
referencePolicy.hashes: originalSourceSha256 hashes the untouched source artifact snapshot. portableFileSha256 in the evidence manifest hashes the exact delivered portable file. Source JPEG/video hashes remain hashes of those original media bytes, never of transformed summaries.
referencePolicy.finalMedia: Actual current1.1.0 final encoded-media decode/ASR/108PNG/native-player evidence is recorded separately in submission/demo-verification.json and submission/evidence/media; source capture records do not themselves verify edited media.
referencePolicy.ordinalDomains: The70 UI event ordinals,300 original observation ordinals,323 DOM event ordinals,19 native receipt ordinals and25 model decision ordinals are separate domains. UI before/afterObservationOrdinal refer to original observations; trustedDomEventOrdinal refers to original DOM events. Preserve these values, do not renumber them. Post-state observation time, action time, native receipt time and CDP paint time remain separate.

scopeBoundaries: The unit/build artifact is a prepublication converged1.1.0 working-tree observation and emitted index-CKOQ29Ge.js; the current published candidate delivers index-BXFW-YOC.js. Build artifacts and hashes are not conflated.

Baseline Bun workload predates optimization and is not commit-pinned by its own record. The retained-public1.0.0 renderer wave is an explicitly historical before-control, never current1.1.0 behavior/media proof.

Performance is measured aggregate workload and same-problem checked-solution reuse, not every-model/judge latency, cold-load performance, isolated compiler/memo attribution, user-study or physical workshop savings.

Actual model selections use an external real completion/default role and genuine native Chrome capabilities; UI review/approval is browser automation. No ChatGPT desktop/in-app-agent, physical-human-presence or field-study proof is implied.

UI event, original observation, DOM event, native receipt and model decision ordinals remain different domains. Source action time, after-observation time, native receipt time and CDP paint time remain distinct.

Original sourceSAR0/1 is unspecified. Main declares setsar1 for the square CDP capture grid without SAR image rescaling; this does not assert original square metadata or final encoded-video verification.
No old1.0.0 video/release hash or14-call trace is substituted for the current candidate. The new165-second MP4 is actually verified in its separate current1.1.0 media record.
No YouTube public upload, Devpost Submitted, eligibility/rights attestation or outcome is verified.

hashPolicy.originalSourceSha256: Hash of exact untouched original artifact snapshot bytes read for export; original hashes identify source provenance even where source containers/paths are transformed
hashPolicy.portableFileSha256: Hash of the exact generated UTF-8 JSON text; byte-for-byte selected binary/CSV copies retain the original byte hash as the expected copy hash. Neither is asserted to equal an original transformed artifact hash.
hashPolicy.inputVersusPortableBoundary: Encoding-input snapshot, later original manifest snapshot and portable exported manifest are distinct hash objects
hashPolicy.verificationScope: Portability export writes/copies selected evidence only. No formatter/linter/build/test suite or validation command is run by this agent; final destination/archive/publication validation belongs to Main. Refresh affected portableFileSha256/portableFileBytes entries after any Main final-media/publication report changes.
